title: rosa canina var. sphaerica
intro: Rosa canina var. sphaerica, commonly known as the Dwarf Wild Rose or Dwarf Rose, is a variety of rose species that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is a small, prickly shrub with fragrant flowers, often used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate various health issues such as digestive problems, skin conditions, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina var. sphaerica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
